Ibergeregg → Muotathal drops about 1406 m over 6 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 18.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Klausen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: 1406 m come off over 11 km at around 22.5%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

pragel-and-ibergeregg-loop.story: Out of Schwyz, one way: 76 km, roughly 1 h 19 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ibergeregg, Muotathal and Pragel Pass. The highest point is about 1,750 m. Ibergeregg Pass and Pragel Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
